method: Original photo texture on articulated Three.js meshes. Analytic two-segment leg IK locks toe contact, lifts the swing foot, preserves segment lengths and advances the root. Upper-body image remains rigid, forearm swings slightly and skirt hem follows thighs.
sourceView: Approved front / slight three-quarter guide image; not a new rear-facing view.
extraNeutralImageGeneration: Tool rejected generation attempts; no generated result was substituted. Approved source reused.
limits: Photographic cutout rig, not a volumetric 3D human or motion capture.
One source view, no natural turning to a new view or reconstruction of hidden surfaces.
Upper-leg hidden pixels are approximated from an existing skin row, and skirt hem deformation conceals the joint boundary.
Close-up can retain paper-puppet/cloth-deformation artifacts; visual quality requires user review.
No lip sync, blinking or newly recorded character voice.
defaultPreview: ../index.html remains the approved static-pose tour; ?walk=1 explicitly enables this study.
deployment: No runtime integration, main merge or public deployment.
